text:
Kelsey: Quick flag — a recruiter noticed several Spanish-language interviewers received English scorecards this morning. looks like 6 interviews affected.

Rohit - Recruiting Ops: ah wow. any sample ids? recruiter attached screenshot showing "Scorecard: English - Standard" but the role was marked es in the panel.

Kelsey: sample int_9011. payload from webhook: ```json {\"interview_id\":\"int_9011\",\"scorecard_handle\":\"onboard-es \"} ``` note trailing space. lookup fell back to en-standard.

i18n Bot: webhook event=interview.created id=int_9011 status=200 payload.scorecard_handle="onboard-es "

Marta - Eng: thanks. looks like the enrichment lambda that normalizes handles trimmed Unicode but left trailing whitespace for locale suffixes when original tag had a non-breaking space. i've got a failing unit that reproduces it.

Rohit - Recruiting Ops: we have live debriefs for these. can we patch them to the correct handle (onboard-es) so panelists see Spanish rubric?

Marta - Eng: yes. run this reporting query to find affected rows: 
```sql
SELECT interview_id, candidate_id, scorecard_handle, created_at
FROM interviews
WHERE scorecard_handle LIKE 'onboard-% ' AND created_at BETWEEN '2024-06-20' AND '2024-06-22';
```
I ran it in staging and got 6 rows.

Kelsey: uploaded CSV to #people-ops-attachments.

Marta - Eng: staging patch applied. sample int_9011 patched from "onboard-es " -> "onboard-es". smoke check shows interviewer UI now loads Spanish rubric. job job-stg-3341.

Emma (People Ops): please run prod patch and ping recruiters when done. also can we add a quick FAQ: what to do if someone sees wrong language rubric?

Marta - Eng: prod patch started job-prod-8821 at 2024-06-22T14:12Z. patched 6 interviews. no regressions.

Rohit - Recruiting Ops: confirmed recruiters saw updated links and panelists could submit feedback in Spanish. thanks.

Marta - Eng: root cause: enrichment used regex \"\s+\" replacement but the string normalization step earlier converted NBSP to regular space inconsistently for some inputs. fix submitted: preserve Unicode non-breaking spaces and then trim only standard spaces. PR #4392.

i18n Bot: deploy enrichment-normalize v3.2 -> prod succeeded (2024-06-22T14:34:01Z)

Marta - Eng: opened ticket RECR-1933 to add an integration test for locale suffix whitespace and add alerting when scorecard lookup falls back to default language.

Emma (People Ops): also adding a short runbook entry: if language mismatch happens, run regex patch to trim trailing whitespace on handles and notify recruiters. i'll post the snippet in Hiring Ops.

Kelsey: great, thanks everyone. one small UX ask from recruiters: can ATS show the language next to the scorecard link in the email? would make it easier to spot.

Rohit - Recruiting Ops: +1. filing REQ-508 to explore including locale metadata in the email template.

Kelsey: closing for now, will reopen if any other cases come in. :white_check_mark:
